title: Configure build script with tsc
description: Configure the TypeScript build process using tsc. Ensure the build script compiles the full project, outputs to dist/, and that compiled files are correct. Add dist/ to .gitignore.
acceptanceCriteria: build script in package.json runs 'tsc -p tsconfig.json'
dist/ directory is excluded from git via .gitignore
dist/ contains compiled .js files corresponding to src/ sources
bin/rocket.js is produced or accessible after build

steps.details: Ensure scripts.build in package.json is set to: 'tsc -p tsconfig.json'. This compiles all files matching the tsconfig include patterns.
Ensure .gitignore at project root contains 'dist/' on its own line. This prevents compiled output from being committed to git.

steps.description: Run a clean build and verify output
steps.details: Run `npm run build`. Check that dist/ is created and contains .js files mirroring the src/ structure. Verify bin/rocket.js is present (either in dist/bin/ or directly in bin/ depending on tsconfig settings).
Add 'clean': 'rm -rf dist/' to scripts in package.json. This allows running `npm run clean && npm run build` for a full rebuild.

technicalNotes: If outDir is 'dist' and rootDir is 'src', the bin/ directory may need a separate tsconfig build step
Consider adding a 'prepublishOnly' script that runs build before npm publish
